# Studentplat

> Studentplat is a web platform for Italian university students to track their academic progress: study days, upcoming exams, passed exams with grades and credits (CFU), arithmetic and credit-weighted averages, and grade trends.

Important notes:

- All personal data (profile, exams, grades) is private and only visible after login. Agents cannot read user data without the user's own session; there is no public API.
- The interface is available in Italian (default) and English. The language is stored in the `lang` cookie and changed with a POST to `/lang`.
- Grades follow the Italian system: 1 to 30, plus "30 e lode" (30 cum laude), stored as 31. A grade below 18 means the exam was not passed.
- Exams (in development) are a shared catalogue: the first user who creates an exam (name and credits) makes it available as a template to every other user, who adds it to their own transcript.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Public presentation of Studentplat and its features (logged-in users are redirected to the dashboard).
- [Login](/login): Log in and sign up (`/login?tab=register` opens the sign-up form).
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Overview of the student's progress (login required).
- [Calendar](/dashboard/calendar): Monthly calendar of the student's exam sessions (`?month=YYYY-MM`, default current month). Selecting a day lets the student schedule an exam from the shared catalogue, move an exam already in their transcript to that day, remove it from the day, or create a new catalogue exam (login required).
- [Profile](/dashboard/profile): Nickname, degree programme, university and total credits of the degree (login required).

## Docs

- [README (English)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kerlooo/Studentplat/master/.github/README.en.md): Features, stack, setup, environment variables and project structure.
